title: Presentation Framework And Projektetage Migration
description: Build @semio-tech/framework-presentation-core (declarative render-independent presentation model) + @semio-tech/framework-presentation-renderer-react (React+reveal.js). Migrate mit-bestand/präsentation/33.projektetage to eg-ice-25 intro (5 slides) with no direct react/reveal deps.
summary:
Fixed reveal.js native auto-animate in the React renderer so it behaves exactly like temp/eg-ice-25.

Root cause: @semio-tech/ui-react surface chrome ships Tailwind v4 preflight, which injects a layered `[hidden]:where(:not([hidden="until-found"])){display:none!important}` rule. reveal.js drives slide visibility by setting inline `display:block` on the off-screen slides it briefly un-hides to MEASURE auto-animate from/to bounding rects (it hides them via opacity:0, not display). Tailwind's LAYERED `!important` outranks reveal's inline display (and even an unlayered author `!important`, per CSS cascade-layer rules), so the `from` slide collapsed to 0x0. reveal then measured the morph origin at the deck's far-left, making every element fly in horizontally from the source position instead of morphing in place.

Fix (native wiring, no hacks):
- Removed the custom `autoAnimateMatcher`/`measureMorphRect` workaround entirely. The renderer now uses reveal's default matcher exactly like eg-ice-25 (`new Reveal(el, { transition })`, autoAnimate default on, data-auto-animate on sections).
- Added `relaxHiddenPreflight()` in the renderer: at deck init it walks document + adopted stylesheets and drops ONLY the `display` declaration from preflight's `[hidden]` reset. This restores the standard non-important UA `[hidden]{display:none}` (ordinary hidden elements stay hidden) while letting reveal's inline `display` win for slides (block for near/measurable, none for far) — native reveal measurement.
- Removed the `left:0;right:0` slide-pinning CSS band-aid (not in eg-ice; it masked the same bug).

Verified live via CDP: morph transforms now stay matrix(1,0,0,1, 0, Y) with HORIZONTAL offset = 0 throughout and Y easing smoothly to 0 (brand->title: 136->0; multi-element title->subtitle: name 51->0, title/subtitle 0; max horizontal offset across all elements = 0). New elements (authors) fade in as unmatched. Matches eg-ice-25 exactly. All renderer (5) and core (6) tests pass; added a renderer test asserting relaxHiddenPreflight strips display from a preflight [hidden] rule while preserving other declarations.
